deployment_facts.observation: QUIC version 1 uses UDP as its transport substrate and integrates encrypted connection establishment.
HTTP/3 maps HTTP semantics onto QUIC and defines endpoint discovery and connection setup mechanisms.
The HTTP/3 specification retains a TCP-based fallback path when QUIC connectivity cannot be established.
